productType.description: A pool heater is a powered device which heats the water of a swimming pool.  Heater pump parts & accessories are replacement parts or accessories for a pool heater.
A pool heater is a powered device which heats the water of a swimming pool.
Pool hoses are round hollow objects to be used in conjunction with a pool vacuum.
Pool ladders are climbing objects used to go in and out of a swimming pool.
Pool liners serve as the internal wall of a vinyl lined pool.
Pool safety supplies is any object mean to provide safety of swimmers.

Pool skimmers are designed to draw water from the surface and suck it through the pool's filtration system. About the top 1/8 inch of water is drawn into the skimmer helping remove the contaminants and debris such as sunscreen, hair and leaves from the pool before they sink to the bottom.  It can also be a net used to filter out debris.
Pool water slides are a structure with a smooth sloping surface for users to slide down, and empty into a swimming pool.
A sauna is a small room or building designed as a place to experience dry or wet heat sessions. The steam and high heat make the bathers perspire.
A sauna heater is a device utilized to provide heat and / or steam to a sauna.
Spa cover lifts are devices used in the assisting of removing or replacing spa covers.
Spa covers cover the surface of the water in order to protect the spa from debris and sediment.
Swimming pool is an artificial body of water for swimming in.
Pool Poles
Spa Chemicals

Arbors are an outdoor garden feature forming a shaded walkway, passageway, or sitting area of vertical posts or pillars that usually support cross-beams and a sturdy open lattice, often upon which woody vines are trained
Artificial greenery panels are sections meant to resemble plant greenery while serving as a privacy partition.
Artificial turf is a surface of synthetic fibers made to look like natural grass.
A beverage tub is an open top circular or oblong container.
A cooler cart is an ice chest or cooler attached or mounted onto a mobile cart.
De-Icing cables can be used to keep gutters and downspouts flowing and help prevent ice from forming under the shingle edge.

De-icing mats are designed to be embedded in concrete or asphalt, either as part of a new installation or when re-paving. They will heat the surface area above freezing, thereby melting any snow or ice. Pedestrians and vehicles can then move securely on the protected surface.
A drain leaf guard is any piece that attaches to the gutter and prevents unwanted materials from entering. Usually, those unwanted materials are leaves, branches, and other outdoor debris.
Fence screens are utilized in conjunction with the chain link fence to provide privacy, provide shade, and block wind.
Garden border edging is pieces of decorative material used to provide an aesthetic edge to a garden.
Garden bridges is a structure built to span a physical obstacle, such as a body of water, valley, or road, without closing the way underneath.

Garden statues is a free-standing sculpture in which the realistic, full-length figures of persons or animals or non-representational forms are carved in a durable material such as wood, metal or stone.
Gazing ball is a mirrored sphere typically displayed atop a conical ceramic or wrought iron stand, and sometimes the grass, as a lawn ornament.
Outdoor curtains is a piece of cloth intended to block or obscure light or drafts.
Outdoor décor is furnishing and decoration.
Outdoor decorative stones are stones meant to serve as decoration, typically used to provide a border or path.
Outdoor flags & banners are pieces of fabric with a distinctive design and colors. They are used as a symbol or for decoration.
Outdoor hanging lantern is a portable hanging source of lighting, typically featuring a protective enclosure for the light source.
Outdoor kitchen serving & storage carts are rolling objects utilized to place items on, or store into.
Outdoor panel privacy screens are free-standing structures designed to block the visibility of an area for privacy.
Outdoor rug is a textile floor covering typically consisting of an upper layer of pile attached to a backing.
Outdoor wall lantern is a wall mounted source of lighting, typically featuring a protective enclosure for the light source.
Patio heaters are portable objects which produce heat for warmth.
Porch swing stands are the structural base of a swing, to where a swing attaches.
A Potting bench or gardening table is a kind of workbench used for small gardening tasks such as transplanting seedlings.
A rain or snow gauge is an instrument used to gather and measure the amount of precipitation over an area in a predefined period of time.
Rain barrels are used to collect and store rain water runoff, typically from rooftops via pipes. Rainwater tanks are devices for collecting and maintaining harvested rain.

Rain chains are alternatives to a downspout. Their purpose is largely decorative, to make a water feature out of the transport of rainwater from the guttering downwards to a drain or to a storage container.
Renewable energy controllers are used to regulate the charge from solar pv or wind system to the battery storage.
Scarecrow decoys are placed in open fields or in gardens to discourage birds from disturbing and feeding on recently cast seed and / or growing crops.
Solar Batteries are simply a battery charged with energy from solar panels.
A sundial is a device that tells the time of day when there is sunlight by the apparent position of the Sun in the sky.
Trellises are an outdoor garden frame that can be used to grow vines or other climbing plants. They can also be used for partitioning a common area.
Weather thermometer is a device that measures temperature or a temperature gradient.
Weathervane is an instrument used for showing the direction of the wind. It is typically used as an architectural ornament to the highest point of a building.

Wind Chimes are a type of percussion instrument constructed from suspended tubes, rods, bells or other objects that are often made of metal or wood. The tubes or rods are suspended along with some type of weight or surface which the tubes or rods can strike when they or another wind-catching surface are blown by the natural movement of air outside.
Wind Sculptures & Spinners are objects are kinetic garden ornaments. They utilize wind to make movement.
A windsock is a conical textile tube that resembles a giant sock. Windsocks can be used as a basic guide to wind direction and speed, or as decoration.
Flagpole brackets & mounts are attachment objects utilized to attach a mailbox to a structure.
A pole used for flying a flag.
Mailbox covers are decorative and / or protective covers for a mailbox

The purpose of a mailbox flag, properly known as a carrier signal flag, is to signal to the postal carrier that there is mail in the box that the customer wants picked up and delivered to its destination
A post used to mount a mailbox onto.
A private box into which mail is delivered, especially one mounted on a post at the entrance to a person's property.
Chia Pets are styled terracotta figurines used to sprout chia, where the chia sprouts grow within a couple of weeks to resemble an animal's fur or person's hair.
Cut flowers are flowers or flower buds (often with some stem and leaf) that have been cut from the plant bearing it. It is usually removed from the plant for decorative use.

Plants are a living organism of the kind exemplified by trees, shrubs, herbs, grasses, ferns, and mosses, typically growing in a permanent site, absorbing water and inorganic substances through its roots, and synthesizing nutrients in its leaves by photosynthesis using the green pigment chlorophyll.

Live Topiary are perennial plants in which the horticultural practice of topiary is conducted. Topiary is conducted by clipping the foliage and twigs of trees, shrubs and subshrubs to develop and maintain clearly defined shapes, whether geometric or fanciful.
Live trees are a woody perennial plant, typically having a single stem or trunk growing to a considerable height and bearing lateral branches at some distance from the ground.
A shrub or bush is a small- to medium-sized perennial woody plant. Unlike herbaceous plants, shrubs have persistent woody stems above the ground. Shrubs can be deciduous or evergreen.

Plant bulbs are any plant that stores its complete life cycle in an underground storage structure. Bulbs or bulb-like plants are usually perennials. They have a period of growth and flowering. This is followed by a period of dormancy where they die back to ground level at the end of each growing season.
A grass seed is a small embryonic plant enclosed in a covering called the seed coat, usually with some stored food. Most grass start, and grow as some type of seed.
A flower seed is a small embryonic plant enclosed in a covering called the seed coat, usually with some stored food. Most flowers start, and grow as some type of seed.
A plant seed is a small embryonic plant enclosed in a covering called the seed coat, usually with some stored food. Most plants start, and grow as some type of seed.

Compost bins are structures used to house and make compost until it can be used in the garden. Most are designed to hasten the decomposition of organic matter through proper aeration and moisture retention.
Composting replacement filters are used in composting bins or pails to suppress odor.

A fertilizer is any material of natural or synthetic origin (other than liming materials) that is applied to soil or to plant tissues to supply one or more plant nutrients essential to the growth of plants.
Garden shepherds hooks are decorative objects, which are staked into the ground and utilized to hang plants or other gardening objects from.
Garden stakes are used to support plants or used as poles for flexible pest fencing.
A growbag is a large plastic bag filled with a growing medium and used for growing plants.
Hanging planters are planters that are hung from a ceiling or structure, used to hang plants.
Herbicides, also commonly known as weed killers, are substances used to control unwanted plants.
Leaf & plant cleaners are utilized to clean dirt, dust, or other undesirables off of leaves or plants.

A mulch is a layer of material applied to the surface of soil. Reasons for applying mulch include conservation of soil moisture, improving fertility and health of the soil, reducing weed growth and enhancing the visual appeal of the area. A mulch is usually, but not exclusively, organic in nature.
Garden netting is used as a solution to keep out problematic animal pests and large bugs from plants or trees.
Plant caddies are rolling platforms in which plants are sat upon for easy re-location and movement.
Plant cages are used as a protective barrier and / or to provide a supporting structure for plants or trees.
Plant covers are objects used to cover plants to protect them from the elements, such as frost, stormy weather, damaging wind, etc.
Plant germination ballast assemblies are used for grow light systems. All grow lights require an electrical ballast to operate, and each ballast has a particular power rating.

Plant germination trays are a gardening tool specifically designed to hold multiple seeds, starting from the germination stage, until the seedlings are ready for transplantation. Plant germination kits are a collection of objects which provide all the necessary materials and ingredients to utilize for plant germination.
Plant growing kits are a collection of objects which provide all the necessary materials and ingredients to utilize for plant growth.
Plant hangers are objects in which plants are hung from; either from the ceiling or from the wall.
A plant pot or planter is a container in which flowers or plants are cultivated and displayed.
Plant saucers are shallow dishes used to catch excess water that drains from a plant pot or container.
Plant stands & racks are objects in which plant pots or containers are sat upon for display.

A plant terrarium is usually a sealable glass container containing soil and plants, and can be opened for maintenance to access the plants inside. However, terrariums can also be open to the atmosphere rather than being sealed. Terrariums are often kept as decorative or ornamental items.
Planter & stand sets are decorative objects, consisting of planter(s) and stand(s), which are used to hold plants.
A planter box is a type of container in the form box that is usually placed outdoors and used for displaying live plants and flowers, but it may also be used for growing herbs or other edible plants.

Plant or pot liners are designed to line the insides of containers or hanging baskets. They hold the soil in one place, especially in the case of wire or other open-design planters. They can also help the soil retain moisture.
Rail planters are a box that used for displaying live plants and flowers, and designed to straddle a railing.

Raised garden kits are self-contained objects that are placed on the ground in which to plant flowers or live plants. These containment units ("beds"), which are usually made of wood, rock, or concrete and which can be of any length or shape.
Seedling heat mats are electric rubber mats which are sized to fit under germination trays. The heat prompts seeds to germinate and grow faster.

A soil tester can determine the current fertility and health of soil. By measuring both the pH level and pinpointing nutrient deficiencies, a soil test can provide the information necessary for maintaining the most optimal fertility each year.
Soil is a mixture of organic matter, minerals, gases, liquids, and organisms that together support life
Wall planters are a box that used for displaying live plants and flowers, and designed to mount or hang from a wall.
Weed barrier fabric is used to reduce the amount of weed infiltration while still allowing water, fertilizer and oxygen to filter through to the soil.
Window boxes are a box that used for displaying live plants and flowers, and designed sit or hang on a window sill
A plant mister is a tool used to sparingly spray your plants with water.
Watering globes are blown glass globes with long thin necks. The water in the globe is slowly released into the soil, providing a steady supply of water for the plants over time.
Adirondack chair cushions are pads stuffed with a mass of soft material, used as a comfortable support for sitting on a Adirondack chair.
An awning is a sheet of canvas or other material stretched on a frame and used to keep the sun or rain off areas, such as a storefront, window, doorway, or deck.
A beach umbrella is a large umbrella used to provide shade on sunny beaches, lawns, etc.
A gazebo is a pavilion structure, sometimes octagonal or turret-shaped, often built in a park, garden or spacious public area.
A greenhouse is a structure with walls and roof made chiefly of transparent material, such as glass or plastic, in which plants requiring regulated climatic conditions are grown.

An outdoor canopy is an overhead roof, or else a structure over which a fabric or metal covering is attached, able to provide shade or shelter from weather conditions such as sun, hail, snow and rain.
Outdoor canopy sidewalls are added to an outdoor canopy to be used to provide shade, or block wind or other weather elements.
Outdoor canopy weights fit around canopy legs to secure an outdoor canopy against the wind.
Outdoor equipment covers are utilized to cover outdoor equipment to product them from the elements.
Outdoor ottoman cushions are pads stuffed with a mass of soft material, used as a comfortable support for sitting or resting legs on an ottoman.
Outdoor seating cushions are pads stuffed with a mass of soft material, used as a comfortable support for sitting on outdoor seating.
Patio furniture covers are utilized to cover patio furniture to product them from the elements.
Patio umbrella base weights canopy legs to secure an outdoor canopy against the wind.
Patio umbrella bases serve as a stand to insert a patio umbrella into, so that it may remain freestanding.
Patio umbrella canopies are fabric objects which are mounted on a patio umbrella frame.
Patio umbrella screens are utilized to drape over an outdoor patio umbrella in order to keep flying insects out.
A patio umbrella is a large umbrella used to provide shade and / or protection from the elements on a patio or outdoor area.

A pergola is an outdoor garden feature forming a shaded walkway, passageway, or sitting area of vertical posts or pillars that usually support cross-beams and a sturdy open lattice, often upon which woody vines are trained.
A plant growing tent is a small to midsized shelter consisting of sheets of fabric or other material used to provide a regulated climatic condition in which plants are grown.
A shade sail is a device to create outdoor shade based on the basic technology as a ship's sail. Shade sails use a flexible membrane tensioned between several anchor points.
Sun Shades are vertical devices or structures utilized to block the sun and provide shade.
Umbrella anchors are devices used to secure an umbrella (usually a beach umbrella) to the ground, in order to keep it from blowing away in the wind.

A carport is a covered structure used to offer limited protection to vehicles, primarily cars, from rain and snow. The structure can either be free standing or attached to a wall. Unlike most structures, a carport does not have four walls, and usually has one or two.

Drip emitters release water to your plants from the mainline tubing. The emitters can be punched directly into the mainline or inserted into the end of a length of 1/4" tubing for plants that aren't close to the mainline. This is the most practical way to emit water to your plants when they aren't evenly spaced.

Drip irrigation filters filter the water flowing through the system. Irrigation regulators reduce the water pressure in your irrigation filter system to the recommended operating pressure of the system. Drip irrigation regulators prevent water surges that can damage your emitters.
Drip irrigation fittings are connector objects that connect to, or connect various parts to a drip irrigation system.
Drip irrigation kits are a collection of objects that when used in conjunction, create a drip irrigation kit.
A drip irrigation manifold is a pipe that branches into several openings, in this case to deliver water to multiple irrigation valves.
Drip irrigation stakes are utilized to stake the irrigation system in place to the ground.
Drip irrigation tubing is utilized to transfer water from one place to another.
Drip irrigation valves are a device that directs or controls the flow of a fluid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways in an irrigation system.
A garden hose, hosepipe, or simply hose is a flexible tube used to convey water.
A hose connectors connect on the end of a hose to connect it with another hose or with a tap or a hose appliance, such as an irrigation sprinkler.
A Hose Reel is a cylindrical spindle made of either metal, fiberglass, or plastic and is used for storing a hose. The most common styles of hose reels are spring driven, hand crank, or motor driven.
Hydroponics systems are a collection of objects that allow the cultivation of plants without using soil.
Irrigation timers allow you to program a number of variables into your automatic irrigation system, including which zones receive water and when, and which days your lawn is watered.
A lawn sprinkler is a mechanism through which water is distributed in a spray so that a residential lawn or garden is irrigated.
Misting systems work by pressurizing water and forcing it through small opening in a specially designed mist nozzle to create fine water droplets

Sprinkler & watering controllers & timers allow you to program a number of variables into your automatic irrigation system, including which zones receive water and when, and which days your lawn is watered.
Sprinkler Head attach to a garden hose, and are utilized to automatically water a lawn and / or plants.

Sprinkler system rain sensors is a device that communicates with your sprinkler timer about the level of rainfall. If enough rain has fallen, then the sensors let the timer know to skip the next cycle and not run.
Drip irrigation valves are a device that directs or controls the flow of a fluid by opening, closing, or partially obstructing various passageways in an sprinkler system.
Watering Nozzles attach to a garden hose, and are utilized to manually water a lawn and / or plants.
This is an ornamental structure in a body of water from which one or more jets of water are pumped into the air.
Pond & Birdbath Heaters & De-Icers are object utilized to heat and / or keep ice from forming.
Pond & Birdbath Water Agitators creates continuous ripples in the water, attracting birds to it and discouraging mosquitos from laying eggs.
Pond Decor
Pond Filtration Supplies
Pond Liners
Pond Netting
Soft blanket intended for multiple scenarios related to a baby's comfort and warmth.

A blanket is a piece of soft cloth large enough either to cover or to enfold a great portion of the user's body, usually when sleeping or otherwise at rest, thereby trapping radiant bodily heat that otherwise would be lost through convection, and so keeping the body warm.

A bed canopy is a decorative bed cover or net. Ornate or decorative fabric is often draped across the upper space between the posts and a solid swath of cloth may create a ceiling, or canopy directly over the bed.

A pillow is a support of the body at rest for comfort, therapy, or decoration. Pillows that aid sleeping are a form of bedding that supports the head and neck. Other types of pillows are designed to support the body when lying down or sitting.
A bed rest pillow is unlike the average sleeping pillow, pillows for bed rest are soft but supportive, allowing you to sit up in bed, watch television, or read. Typically.
Decorative bed object to be draped over a bed toward bottom.

A bed sheet is a rectangular piece of cloth used either singly or in a pair as bedding, being placed immediately below or above bed occupants. A top sheet, in the many countries where they are used, is a flat sheet, immediately under which bed occupants lie.

A bed skirt or valance is a piece of decorative fabric that is placed between the mattress and the box spring of a bed. The purpose of a bed skirt is to give a stylish appearance to a bed without exposing the sides of the box spring or any space under the bed that may be used for storage.
Bedding fasteners help keep your bedding articles in place.
A bedding ensemble that comes in a set.
A complete set of bedding that comes in a bag.

A bedspread is a lightweight, decorative bed covering that can be used alone in warm weather or as a decorative addition to a comforter in cold weather. Bedspreads are ideal bed coverings during spring and summer months and add an extra element of style to your bed during fall and winter. A coverlet is an extra layer of bedding used for decoration or warmth. Coverlets work well in cold climates or seasons as an additional layer atop your comforter or duvet, but they can also be used as your main bedding option in warm climates or seasons. They come in a variety of materials, most commonly cotton or linen. Adding a coverlet is an easy way to change your bedding, just remove, fold, or display however you desire.

A body pillow is a long, narrow pillow that is meant to be cradled between your legs as you sleep on your side. The purpose of a body pillow is to improve spinal alignment and aid in pressure point relief.

A comforter is a thick, quilted, fluffy blanket that is used to keep you warm. It is usually filled with filler which is quilted or stitched to secure the filling and keep it evenly distributed. A duvet is a type of bedding consisting of a soft flat bag filled with down, feathers, wool, silk or a synthetic alternative.
Pillow that has a curved design to adapt to the contours of a sleeper's neck and shoulders.
An electric blanket is a blanket that contains integrated electrical heating wires.
An encasement covers and protects the mattresses. Usually zippered around one side. Protects against allergens, bed bugs, etc.

Primarily designed to protect mattress from stains and wear, mattress pads usually fit like a fitted sheet covering not just the top, but all four sides of the mattress and may additionally include a filled top layer to provide extra comfort.

Unlike mattress pads, which can be thin and fit like a sheet, mattress toppers are typically thick and are designed to sit on top of the mattress providing an extra layer of comfort. A mattress topper sits on top of your mattress and provides support that can prolong a mattress's life by reducing pressure on the springs, delaying any sagging or general wear. Combine a mattress topper with regularly flipping your mattress and you could see your mattress provide full support for longer.
Pillow that is designed to support the neck and keep the upper body aligned during sleep.

A pillow protector prolongs the life of a pillow and are highly recommended for expensive pillows. These zippered fabric cases protect against dirt and oil, keeping pillows fresh and clean. The main purpose of a pillow protector is to preserve a pillow.
Unlike with pillowcases, shams are used to cover pillows for decorative purpose. Typically pillow shams contain a tuck flap on the back and all four sides are finished with flange or cording.
Used to cover the pillows that are used for actual sleeping vs decorative ones, pillowcases are often open at one end and contain a flange on opening.

A quilt is a multi-layered textile, traditionally composed of two or more layers of fibers. Commonly 3 layers are used. These layers include a woven cloth top, a layer of batting or wadding, and a woven back combined using the techniques of quilting.

A slumber bag is similar to a sleeping bag use as an insulated covering for a person, it’s essentially a lightweight blanket that can be closed with a zipper or similar means to form a tube, which functions as lightweight, portable bedding. A nap mat is mat for children to sleep on.

A throw is smaller than a blanket. Throws can be draped over couches, chairs, the end of beds, hung on blanket racks or even hung on a wall. Throws are also used to provide warmth and comfort while relaxing on a couch or chair. They are made from a wide variety of materials.
A twin bed bridge is a product specially designed to fill the gap between the two twin mattresses and convert them to a king bed.
A waterbed heater is a heating device that lets you warm your waterbed effectively and efficiently while maintaining a constant temperature.

A waterbed liner protects your waterbed frame and your floors from any spilled water, in case you mattress gets punctured of damaged. When buying a safety liner, choose a leak proof one that suits the size of your mattress.
Pillow that elevates the head, shoulders, and torso which can relieve certain health issues.

Anti-fatigue mats are mats designed to reduce fatigue caused by standing for long periods on a hard surface (e.g., cement floors). Fatigue-reducing mats can be made of various materials including rubber, carpeting materials, vinyl, and wood.
A rug that covers a limited area of floor space in a room.
An absorbent floor area rug commonly placed outside of a shower or bath tub.
Temporary carpet covering designed for high use areas often made of vinyl or plastic.
Doormat is a mat placed before or inside a door for wiping dirt from the shoes.  A floor mat is any kind of mat you put on a floor (anywhere, including cars).
A rug used in front of a fireplace or stove and designed to protect nearby flooring from sparks and other types of damage.
Accent rug with hair-on-hide construction and available in a variety of shapes, but often with an animal hide style.
Floor mats intended for use in the kitchen.

A rug pad is a sticky buffer between your rug and floor, kind of like double-sided tape but without the residue actual tape would leave behind. A rug pad provides a foundation for your rug, reduces wear, and prevents holes and fraying around the edges.
Long and narrow rugs designed to be used in hallways, staircases and other high traffic areas.
A mixture of bath product types in one set
Adhesive decal that attaches to a shower or bathtub floor and helps prevent your feet from slipping when wet.
Bath pillows are designed to be placed at bath tub to make the tub a more comfortable place.
Bathroom butlers are racks/stands/organizers that hold towels and bathroom accessories.
Bathroom Canisters & Sets are containers that are used to organize items on a bathroom countertop.
Bathroom Cosmetic & Toiletry Organizers are containers that are used to organize cosmetics and toiletry products on a bathroom countertop, on a shelf, or in a drawer or cabinet.

A bathroom linen & accessory set is a set of items used in the bathroom such as towels, linens, rugs, mats, trash bin, canisters, tumblers, shower curtains, soap & lotion dispenser, toothbrush dispenser, etc.
A bathroom tumbler is a glass or cup that is kept in the bathroom for drinking or other uses as placement holder.
A shower splash guard is an installed, fixed, rigid fitting made of plastic or glass that prevent water from a shower from splashing out of the bathtub and onto the floor.
Decorative tissue holder to keep wet & dry facial tissues
Plastic or rubber mat placed inside a shower or bathtub floor that helps prevent your feet from slipping when wet. This is not the absorbent bath rug that belongs outside the bathtub or shower.
Shower Curtain Rings are the hooks to fix the curtain to the shower curtain rod.
Shower Curtain Rods are the support holder to hang Shower Curtains and with Shower Curtain Rings.

A shower curtain is a curtain that keeps water from splashing out of the shower area. curtain, drape, drapery, pall, mantle - hanging cloth used as a blind (especially for a window) shower bath, shower stall - booth for washing yourself, usually in a bathroom. The shower curtain liner is the first line of defense against moisture leakage. When hung and used properly, a shower curtain liner can do a great job keeping water where it is supposed to be. Always make sure the liner is inside of the tub basin when showering, even though the curtain is outside.

A Soap & Lotion dispenser pump is used on containers of liquids to help dispensing. They might be used on bottles, jars, or tubes. Often the contents are viscous liquids such as creams and lotions. This is just the pump component.
Soap & Lotion dispenser imply a container which is designed to release a specific amount of its content, usually liquids, creams, or powders/fine granular.

Soap Dishes & Holders is a shallow, open container or platform where a bar of soap may be placed to dry after use. Soap dishes are usually located in or near a sink, shower, or bathtub. Most soap dishes are made from waterproof materials such as plastic, ceramic, metal, or glass, though some are made from bamboo.
Toilet Lid & Tank Covers are decorative objects that slip over a toilet tank or lid.
Toilet Paper Holders old and / or dispense toilet paper.
Toilet Paper Storage Containers are used as storage to hold and store toilet papers in bathrooms.
Toilet Seat Covers can either be a decorative object that slips over a toilet seat, or a disposable cover that is used to create a sanitary barrier between the toilet and user.
Toothbrush Holders as a bathroom accessories to place tooth brush(es) and sometimes toothpaste.
A Towel & Washcloth is a piece of absorbent fabric used for drying or wiping a body or a surface.
An object utilized to house or hold a candle or candle stick designed for indoor use.
Candle shades and covers are placed over a candle to reduce the effects of drafts and helping fragrance distribution by making the candle flame burn steadier.
A candle wick is usually a braided cotton that holds the flame of an oil lamp or candle.

A candle snuffer, candle extinguisher, or douter is an instrument used to extinguish burning candles, consisting of a small cone at the end of a handle. The use of a snuffer helps to avoid problems associated with blowing hot wax.
Lamp Oil is the fuel utilized in an oil lamp, torch, or oil lantern.  It is a petroleum-based oil that is refined to burn in an odorless, soot-free manner.
An object utilized to house or hold a candle or candle stick designed for outdoor use.
A wick trimmer is a tool similar to scissors, used to trim down the wicks of candles.
A collection of items utilized for baking.
A flat, metal pan used in an oven for baking cookies or other items.
Baking cups (aka muffin cups) are used to line muffin and cupcake tins when making cupcakes, muffins or fairy cakes.
These are dishes that are specifically used for baking and to create Casseroles.
A baking mat is made of high-quality, food-grade silicone and fiberglass, and it is most often used to cover cookie sheets when baking.

In cooking, a sifter is used to separate and break up clumps in dry ingredients such as flour, as well as to aerate and combine them. A strainer is a form of sieve used to separate suspended solids from a liquid by filtration.

Baking Stencils are used to produce an image or pattern by applying pigment or ingredients to the surface of a food item to create a pattern or image by only allowing the pigment to reach some parts of the surface.
A bread pan, also called a loaf pan, is a kitchen utensil in the form of a container in which bread is baked. Its function is to shape bread while it is rising during baking.
Cake board is a piece of hardboard covered in foil (usually silver but other colors are available) and around 3-4 mm thick.
Cake Boxes are containers specifically designed to house and transport cakes.
A cake pan is a pan designed to bake a cake in, in an oven.

A cake stand is a structural, stool like object on which cake and other pastries are decorated and served. Cake stands are generally a single plate connected to a pedestal or multiple plates in a tower like hosting object.
Cake topper is a small model that sits on top of a cake
The cake turntable is the cake decoration tool that is indispensable in bakery kitchens and bakeries.
A container used in various techniques of food preparation to shape the finished dish into a specific shape.
A device with sharp edges for cutting cookie dough into a particular shape
A cookie press is a device for making pressed cookies. It consists of a cylinder with a plunger on one end, which is used to extrude cookie dough through a small hole at the other end.

A kitchen utensil that is used for placing cooked foods onto a surface that will enable the food to be cooled on all sides after being baked, either food still in a hot pan or food removed from a baking sheet or pan and placed directly onto the rack.
An object in which cotton candy is put upon and is utilized as handle.
Cupcake Corer creates a perfect hole in the center of a baked cupcake for filling with icing or other food material.
Cupcake liners are papers used to contain batter poured into muffin tins. Made of paper or foil, they are usually corrugated and are often decorative.
A collection of items utilized for making cupcakes.

A triangular-shaped bag made from cloth, paper, plastic, that is squeezed by hand to pipe semi-solid foods by pressing them through a narrow opening at one end often fitted with a shaped nozzle, for many purposes including in particular cake decoration and icing.
Dough & Empanada Presses mold dough into a specific shape and allow for the creation of dumplings or dough filled with other food material.

A roller docker, rolling docker, dough docker, roto-fork, or simply docker is a food preparation utensil which resembles either a small, spiked rolling pin, or a small rotary tiller. It is used to pierce bread dough, cracker dough, pizza dough or pastry dough to prevent over rising or blistering.
Icing Decorating Tips & Sets are the nozzle or a collection of nozzles used to dispense icing in a decorating manner.
Icing Smoothers & Spatulas are a tool or utensil used to smooth or apply icing.
Lollipop & Treat Sticks serve as handles to lollipop and other candy / treats.
A mixing bowl is a deep bowl that is particularly well suited for mixing ingredients together in. These come in many materials, such as stainless steel, ceramic, glass, and plastic.
A muffin or cupcake pan is a mold in which muffins or cupcakes are baked.  Individual Baking Molds are single contains used to for baking.
Pie & Tart Pans are pans specifically designed to house a pie or a tart.
A pie crust shield is a baking tool that covers the outer edge of a pie to keep it from over-browning or burning while the pie bakes.

A pie iron—also called pudgy pie iron, sandwich toaster, snackwicher, jaffle iron, or toastie iron—is a cooking appliance that consists of two hinged concave, round or square, cast iron or aluminum plates on long handles.
Pizza Stones & Pans are pans or objects specifically designed for a pizza to be cooked on.
A ramekin is a small glazed ceramic, plastic, stainless steel or glass bowl used for cooking and serving various dishes.

A rolling pin is a cylindrical food preparation utensil used to shape and flatten dough. Two styles of rolling pin are found: rollers and rods. Roller types consists of a thick cylinder with small handles at each end; rod type rolling pins are usually thin tapered batons.

Printed visual art that contains a graphic image that is reproduced onto paper (or some other material) using various methods. In general, these are considered fine or decorative art and use higher quality materials than mass-produced posters.  Not inclusive of art printed on canvas.
Wall art that features an image printed onto canvas. Canvas prints are often used in interior design and feature stock images or personal photographs.

Drawing is a form of visual art in which a person uses various drawing instruments to mark paper or another two-dimensional medium. Instruments include graphite pencils, pen and ink, various kinds of paints, inked brushes, colored pencils, crayons, charcoal, chalk, pastels, various kinds of erasers, markers, styluses, and various metals (such as silverpoint). Not inclusive of printed reproductions, which would instead be an art print.
Folk art covers all forms of visual art made in the context of folk culture. Definitions vary, but generally the objects have practical utility of some kind, rather than being exclusively decorative.
Visual art in which more than one medium is used to create a wall-hung or free-standing art piece.

Fine or decorative painted wall art pieces that are typically some type of portrait, landscape, abstract image, or any title that is applied to a base using a painted-on material (oil, acrylic, etc.). Not inclusive of printed reproductions, which would instead be an art print.
Wall art or decorative piece that features a photographic image as the main title. The image may represent a variety of styles, ranging from fine art to abstract to children's designs.

A picture frame is a simultaneously protective and decorative edging for a picture, such as a painting or photograph. It makes displaying the work safer and easier and both sets the picture apart from its surroundings and aesthetically integrates it with them
Posters are mass-produced printed wall art that often feature photographic images or illustrations intended for commercial use or cheap decor.

Sculpture is the branch of the visual arts that operates in three dimensions. It is one of the plastic arts. Durable sculptural processes originally used carving (the removal of material) and modelling (the addition of material, as clay), in stone, metal, ceramics, wood and other materials but, since Modernism, there has been an almost complete freedom of materials and process. A wide variety of materials may be worked by removal such as carving, assembled by welding or modelling, or molded or cast.
Enclosed frame or display box containing art works or objects presented in a thematic, artistic way.
Stained glass are colored pieces of glass joined together to make a decorative object

A suncatcher or light catcher is a small reflective, refractive, and/or iridescent ornament. It may include glass or nacre pieces and be hung indoors near a window to "catch" sunlight. A suncatcher is like the optical equivalent of a wind chime.
Textile fabric art piece with designs made from weaving or embroidering colored thread onto the piece.
Textile arts are arts and crafts that use plant, animal, or synthetic fibers to construct practical or decorative objects
A Basting Brush is a culinary brush also called as pastry brush that is specifically used for baking, basting meats, fish, poultry, and other food items that are being roasted.
This is an object utilized in cooking to provide different shapes to boiled eggs.
An Egg Separators allows to separate egg yolk from the egg white.
Fat Separators are also be called gravy strainers or soup strainers, is a measuring cups that make it easy to delete fat stock for gravies and sauces.
Ice Cube Molds & Trays are designed to be filled water in a freezer until the water freezes into ice in many shapes such as square, rectangular, round etc.
Meat Baster is a cooking tool to remove juices as well as add during meat preparations.
Pasta & Dumpling Molds & Stamps are cooking accessories to give good shape of dough cutting out in perfect professional look.
A Pastry brush is a culinary brush also called as basting brush used to spread butter, oil or glaze on Pastries and other food items
Artificial (fake) flowers are generally made of plastic or fabric and are intended to resemble live cut or potted flowers.
Artificial (fake) fruits or vegetables are generally made of plastic or fabric and are intended to resemble edible fruit or vegetables.
Artificial (fake) plants are generally made of plastic or fabric and are intended to resemble living plants. These items often include a vase or hanging pot.
Shaped and sculpted artificial trees (topiary) that appear living, but require no maintenance, water or sunlight.
Artificial trees and shrubs are designed to appear living, but require no maintenance, water or sunlight.
Curtain Holdbacks are objects utilized to hold curtains in a back / open position.
A curtain ring is a small clip for suspending a curtain.
Curtain rod holders are hardware utilized to hold up a curtain rod.
Curtain Rod is an object that a curtain is hung from. Rod sets are a collection of objects used to mount curtains.

A curtain track uses an internal tracking system with either glides or carriers to attach the curtain. They are generally made from aluminum and come in a variety of styles, colors and sizes to suit both residential and commercial applications.

A window valance is a form of window treatment that covers the uppermost part of the window and can be hung alone or paired with window blinds, or curtains. Valances are a popular decorative choice in concealing drapery hardware. Window valances were popular in Victorian interior design. A curtain is a piece of cloth intended to block or obscure light, or drafts, or water. A curtain is also the movable screen or drape in a theater that separates the stage from the auditorium or that serves as a backdrop
Wall shelves that are mounted using brackets and hardware that is hidden within the shelf, giving the appearance of "floating" on the wall.
These are individual slats utilized to repair a window blind.

A wall decal, also known as a wall sticker, wall tattoo, or wall vinyl, is a vinyl sticker that is affixed to a wall or other smooth surface for decoration and informational purposes. Wall decals are cut with vinyl cutting machines.
Wall measuring growth chart are used to compare your child's height at various stages of growth.

A pediment is an architectural element found particularly in Classical, Neoclassical and Baroque architecture, and its derivatives, consisting of a gable, usually of a triangular shape, placed above the horizontal structure of the lintel, or entablature, if supported by columns.
An ornamental object consisting of two or three-dimensional representative or abstract forms, especially by carving stone or wood or by casting metal or plaster.
Window covering with long slats often made of a hard material. They are often adjustable to allow different amounts of light through the window.
Window film is a thin laminate film that can be installed to the interior or exterior of glass surfaces in automobiles and boats and also to the interior or exterior of glass in homes and buildings
Window Alert decals help prevent wild birds from accidentally striking windows.
Window covering that does not use slats or vanes and are often a softer item, often made with fabric.

A window shutter is a solid and stable window covering usually consisting of a frame of vertical stiles and horizontal rails. Set within this frame can be louvers, solid panels, fabric, glass and almost any other item that can be mounted within a frame.

productType.description: Remote control to operate a ceiling fan or light
A ceiling fan downrod is a metal pipe that connects the motor housing to the mounting hardware, stabilizing the ceiling fan and reducing the potential for wobbling.

A ceiling fan lighting kit is an add-on for a ceiling fan that was designed with the capability to accept it.  It will generally consist of a replacement base cap (with capacity to support a shade or shades and bulb holders), necessary mounting hardware and wiring, and sometimes the required light bulbs.
Decorative Hooks for ceiling fans
A ceiling fan is a mechanical fan mounted on the ceiling of a room or space, usually electrically powered, suspended from the ceiling of a room
Light fixtures designed to mount on the ceiling.

A chandelier is a branched ornamental light fixture designed to be mounted on ceilings or walls. Chandeliers are often ornate, and normally use incandescent light bulbs, though some modern designs also use fluorescent lamps and recently LEDs.
An emergency light is a battery-backed lighting source
Fan blade arms are the actual fan component needed for a ceiling fan fan blades.
Flat blades are the actual fan component that rotate to give air in a ceiling fan.
A ceiling light that is mounted flush to the ceiling surface.

Powerful ceiling mounted light fixtures designed to provide the appropriate foot-candle levels to adequately illuminate large indoor vertical as well as horizontal space like manufacturing facilities, gymnasiums, warehouses, large department stores, factories, and more.
Hanging light fixture designed to be mounted on the ceiling.
Picture lights are wall mounted lights installed directly onto the wall above the artwork to provide light around
Light fixture installed into a hollow opening in the ceiling (also known as can lights).

A pitter is a device for removing the pit from a fruit or vegetable, leaving the cherry relatively intact. Many styles of cherry pitters exist, including small tools held in the hand, domestic crank-operated machines with a hopper, and industrial machines.

Zesters are exclusively used for citrus fruits to get long, thin strips of zest. They're small with just a few round holes that you scrape along the fruit. A grater, on the other hand, is multipurpose. You can zest citrus with a grater, but you can't necessarily shred veggies with a zester.
A kitchen utensil that can be used to grind, crush, mince, or cut herbs into smaller bits for seasoning sauces, soups, salads, and other foods.

Kitchen Knives & Cutlery Sets are used for cutting meat, dicing vegetables, disjointing some cuts, slicing herbs, and chopping nuts. Carving knives are used for slicing and carving dense meats. Slicing knives are used for cutting thinner slices of roast, fruit and vegetables.

A kitchen tool, specifically made for food preparation, that is more versatile than a standard pair of cutting scissors. A mandoline slicer is a device made up of a flat surface fitted with a sharp blade, that lets you slice vegetables and fruits quickly, precisely and (ideally) safely. You simply slide the item back and forth across the blade and your perfect, uniform slices emerge below.

Carving forks are used to hold foods securely in place as well as keeping hands away from the sharp blades of the knives as food is being prepared. Longer tines will allow the fork to go deeper into the food so the larger pieces of meat can be kept stable as they are carved.

delete.description:
Use this API when you want to permanently retire an item identified by its SKU.

**Retiring virtual pack items:** Virtual pack offers can also be retired with this endpoint. For a virtual pack, use the bundle SKU returned in the virtual pack retrieval response (for example, `bundles[].sku`). This value is system-generated by Walmart and often matches the virtual pack item ID.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: An arbitrary alphanumeric unique ID, specified by the seller, which identifies each item. Special characters in the sku needing encoding are: ':', '/', '?', '#', '[', ']', '@', '!', '$', '&', "'", '(', ')', '*', '+', ',', ';', '=', as well as '%' itself. Other characters don't need to be encoded.

A lag time of 2 days or more may require category-level approval; submit a lag time exception request if needed. Send a JSON or XML feed and set feedType=lagtime. For schema definitions and samples, download LagTimeException.zip.

Lag time of two days or more requires approval at the item setup category level. Please refer to the Request Lag Time Exceptions article for more details on this process. Download the Lag Time JSON schema from the below directory: LagTimeException.zip.

Make sure to encode space with %20. Other characters don't need to be encoded.

post.description:
Create one or more webhook subscriptions for event notifications by selecting an event type, event version, resource name, and providing a destination event URL. Use the Get Event Types API to retrieve available event types, versions, and resource names. Configure the eventUrl to receive notifications.

URL authentication options
- If authMethod is BASIC_AUTH, Walmart passes an authentication header to the eventUrl using authHeaderName as the header key and the Base64-encoded userName:password as the value.
- If authMethod is HMAC, Walmart passes an authentication header to the eventUrl using authHeaderName as the header key and HMACSHA256 of the complete response as the value, with clientSecret as the key.
- If authMethod is OAUTH, Walmart makes a POST call to authUrl to generate a token with request body "grant_type=client_credentials" and headers: (1) Authorization header using authHeaderName as the key and Base64-encoded clientId:clientSecret as the value, (2) Accept: "application/json; charset=UTF-8", (3) Content-Type: "application/x-www-form-urlencoded; charset=ISO-8859-1", and (4) any custom headers provided in headers. The authUrl must return HTTP 200 with access_token and expires_in fields. When sending notifications to eventUrl, Walmart includes the access_token in headers using authHeaderName as the key and value "Bearer <access_token>", along with any custom headers provided in headers.

This API retrieves all report requests that match your query parameters.

You can only view report requests created within the last 30 days.

parameters.name: reportVersion
parameters.description: Specifies the version of the report. For example, `v1`.

parameters.name: requestStatus
parameters.description: Filters report requests by status. Valid values are `RECEIVED`, `INPROGRESS`, `READY`, or `ERROR`.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: Filters report requests by their creation source. Valid values are `SC` (Seller Center), `API`, or `Scheduler`.

parameters.description: Returns report requests submitted on or after this timestamp. Use ISO 8601 format (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ`).

value.detail: Your shipment contains dangerous goods or hazardous material that cannot be shipped with priority services. Select another service to ship this order, or submit a third-party tracking number.

The seller is enrolled in Out Of Country (Cross Border Trade) but required fields (Harmonized System code, country of origin, or product URL) are missing or are invalid. Correct the order details or submit a third-party tracking number.

500.description: Internal server error. An unexpected error occurred. For Cross Border Trade enrolled orders, this indicates label generation failure. Submit a third-party tracking number if the error persists.

errors.description: An internal server error occurred.
errors.info: Retry the request. If the issue persists, contact support.

value.detail: SWW label cannot be generated for this Cross Border Trade enrolled order. Eligible reasons: carrier ineligibility, hazmat restrictions, or shipment dimensions exceeding carrier limits. Submit a third-party tracking number.

post.description: You can cancel one or more order lines. You must include a purchaseOrderId when cancelling an order line. The response to a successful call contains the order with the cancelled line items

parameters.name: purchaseOrderId
parameters.description: Unique Walmart `purchaseOrderId` that identifies the purchase order.

parameters.name: WM_SANDBOX
parameters.description: Include this header to access the Marketplace dynamic sandbox environment. The dynamic sandbox is only available in the US market.

orderLine.description: Array of objects, each specifying cancellation details for an individual order line.

lineNumber.description: Identifier of the specific order line to be cancelled.

orderLineStatus.description: Array of status update objects, each describing a cancellation status change.

cancellationReason.description:
Reason for cancellation. Example: 'CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_SELLER_TO_CANCEL'.

Cancellation reason should not be "CUSTOMER_REQUESTED_SELLER_TO_CANCEL" for non intent to cancel orders'

Cancellation reason should not be
"SELLER_CANCEL_FRAUD_STOP_SHIPMENT" for non fraudulent orders. If you suspect fraud, contact Walmart Risk Prevention Team (MPFraudReq@customercare.walmart.com). Include PO details and reason you suspect the order. We will contact you in 2-4 hours. If your suspicion of fraud is proven, we will cancel the order and notify you.

If you select the cancellation reason as "SELLER_CANCEL_OUT_OF_STOCK", Walmart will mark the specific item as out of stock in the selected warehouse. To make the item available for sale again, please replenish its inventory.

Use SELLER_CANCEL_OUT_OF_STOCK to report inventory shortages.

get.description:
Retrieves the details of all the orders for specified search criteria.

Only orders created in last 180 days and a maximum of 10000 orders can be fetched at a time. Attempting to download more than 10000 orders will return an error.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Seller provided product identifier used to filter orders by stock keeping unit.

parameters.name: customerOrderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier assigned by the customer to place the order.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the Walmart purchase order. A single customer order can map to multiple purchase orders.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Status of purchase order line. Valid statuses are: Created, Acknowledged, Shipped, Delivered and Cancelled.

parameters.name: createdStartDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were created after this date. Default is current date - 7 days. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

parameters.name: createdEndDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were created before this date. Default is current date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

parameters.name: fromExpectedShipDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date after this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)

parameters.name: toExpectedShipDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date before this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)

parameters.name: lastModifiedStartDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were modified after this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

parameters.name: lastModifiedEndDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were modified before this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of orders to return per response. Must not exceed 200.

parameters.name: productInfo
parameters.description: Include product image URL and weight in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: shipNodeType
parameters.description: Filter by fulfillment node type. Valid values are SellerFulfilled, WFSFulfilled, and 3PLFulfilled. Default is SellerFulfilled.

parameters.name: shippingProgramType
parameters.description: Filter by shipping program. Valid values are TWO_DAY or ONE_DAY.

parameters.name: replacementInfo
parameters.description: Include replacement order attributes (originalCustomerOrderID, orderType) in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: orderType
parameters.description: Filter by order type. Valid values are REGULAR, REPLACEMENT, PREORDER. Replacement orders appear only if replacementInfo is true.

parameters.name: incentiveInfo
parameters.description: Include incentive attributes (incentiveType, originalPrice, walmartFundedIncentive, originalReferralFee, reducedReferralFeeDiscount) in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: WM_SANDBOX
parameters.description: Include this header to access the Marketplace dynamic sandbox environment. The dynamic sandbox is only available in the US market.

get.description: Retrieves an order detail for a specific purchaseOrderId. In some cases, order lines may include additional details in miscAttributes (for example, pet-related details).

parameters.name: purchaseOrderId
parameters.description: Unique Walmart `purchaseOrderId` that identifies the purchase order.

parameters.name: productInfo
parameters.description: Include product image URL and weight in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: replacementInfo
parameters.description: Include replacement order attributes (originalCustomerOrderID, orderType) in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: incentiveInfo
parameters.description: Include incentive attributes (incentiveType, originalPrice, walmartFundedIncentive, originalReferralFee, reducedReferralFeeDiscount) in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: WM_SANDBOX
parameters.description: Include this header to access the Marketplace dynamic sandbox environment. The dynamic sandbox is only available in the US market.

purchaseOrderId.description: A unique ID associated with the seller's purchase order

customerOrderId.description: A unique ID associated with the sales order for specified customer

customerEmailId.description: The email address of the customer for the sales order

orderDate.description: The date the customer submitted the sales order, in ISO 8601 format. Example: '2025-06-15T06:00:00Z'

buyerId.description: Unique ID associated with the specified buyer

orderType.description: Specifies if the order is a regular order, replacement order or preorder. Possible values are REGULAR , REPLACEMENT or PREORDER

estimatedDeliveryDate.description: The estimated time and date for the delivery of the item, in Unix epoch format.

estimatedShipDate.description: The estimated time and date when the item will be shipped, in Unix epoch format.

methodCode.description: The shipping method. Can be one of the following: Standard, Express, OneDay, WhiteGlove, Value or Freight.

name.description: The name for the person/place of shipping address

address1.description: The first line of the shipping address

address2.description: The second line of the shipping address

city.description: The city of the shipping address

state.description: The state of the shipping address

postalCode.description: The zip code of the shipping address

country.description: The country of the shipping address

postalAddress.description: Elements of the customer's postal address

carrierMethodName.description: The carrier method name can be one of the following: FEDEX_HOME_DELIVERY, FEDEX_EXPRESS, FEDEX_2DAY_EXPRESS, FEDEX_OVERNIGHT, FEDEX_GROUND_ECONOMY, UPS_GROUND, UPS_3DAY_SELECT, UPS_2DAY_AIR, UPS_NEXTDAY_AIR, UPS_SUREPOST, USPS_GROUND, USPS_PRIORITY_MAIL or USPS_PRIORITY_MAIL_EXPRESS

shippingInfo.description: The shipping information provided by the customer to the seller

orderLine.description: A list of order lines in the order

lineNumber.description: Identifier of the specific order line to be cancelled.

productName.description: The name of the product associated with the line item. Example: 'Kenmore CF1' or '2086883 Canister Secondary Filter Generic 2 Pack'

sku.description: An arbitrary alphanumeric unique ID, assigned to each item in the item file

condition.description: Information about the condition of the product.

imageUrl.description: Optional. Web URL for the image of the item.

unit.description: Standard value of measurement of the item. Example: 'Pounds'

weight.description: Optional. Weight information for the item.

item.description: The information for the item on the orderLine

type.description: Type of incentive applied to the orderLine. Possible values are: Walmart funded and Reduced referral

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this charge (such as USD).

amount.description: Numeric value of the charge in the specified currency (such as 9.99).

get.description:
Retrieves all the orders with line items that are in the "created" status, that is, these orders have been released from the Walmart Order Management System to the seller for processing. The released orders are the orders that are ready for a seller to fulfill.

Only orders created in last 180 days and a maximum of 10000 orders can be fetched at a time. Attempting to download more than 10000 orders will return an error.

parameters.name: createdStartDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were created after this date. Default is current date - 7 days. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

parameters.name: createdEndDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were created before this date. Default is current date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of orders to return per response. Must not exceed 200.

parameters.name: productInfo
parameters.description: Include product image URL and weight in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: shipNodeType
parameters.description: Filter by fulfillment node type. Valid values are SellerFulfilled, WFSFulfilled, and 3PLFulfilled. Default is SellerFulfilled.

parameters.name: sku
parameters.description: Seller provided product identifier used to filter orders by stock keeping unit.

parameters.name: customerOrderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier assigned by the customer to place the order.

parameters.name: purchaseOrderId
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the Walmart purchase order. A single customer order can map to multiple purchase orders.

parameters.name: fromExpectedShipDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date after this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)

parameters.name: toExpectedShipDate
parameters.description: Fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date before this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)

parameters.name: shippingProgramType
parameters.description: Filter by shipping program. Valid values are TWO_DAY or ONE_DAY.

parameters.name: replacementInfo
parameters.description: Include replacement order attributes (originalCustomerOrderID, orderType) in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: orderType
parameters.description: Filter by order type. Valid values are REGULAR, REPLACEMENT, PREORDER. Replacement orders appear only if replacementInfo is true.

parameters.name: incentiveInfo
parameters.description: Include incentive attributes (incentiveType, originalPrice, walmartFundedIncentive, originalReferralFee, reducedReferralFeeDiscount) in the response when true. Valid values are true or false.

parameters.name: WM_SANDBOX
parameters.description: Include this header to access the Marketplace dynamic sandbox environment. The dynamic sandbox is only available in the US market.

accessToken.description:
Access token required for authenticating API requests.

To obtain a token, call `POST https://marketplace.walmartapis.com/v3/token` with your client ID and client secret using the client credentials grant type. Refer to the [Token API documentation](https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/get-an-access-token) for details.

Pass the resulting token in the `WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN` header with every API request.

get.description: The Entity Match API allows the Payout Service Providers (PSPs) to access entity profile data. The data includes seller's tax ID, legal business name, and the country of incorporation. PSPs can use this API to validate a seller's entity details during onboarding and payout processes.

parameters.description: Access token obtained from the Token API. This is required for authenticating requests to Walmart Marketplace APIs.

parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Walmart service being called.

body.description: Entity profile details returned for the seller.

businessRegistrationNumber.description: Seller business identifier used for entity matching. This could be the business registration number or tax identifier depending on country. Example: ABCD001122

name.description: Seller legal business name as registered with the issuing authority. Example: Business Name.

countryOfIncorporation.description: Country where the seller business is incorporated (typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code). Example: US

status.description: Overall outcome of the request. Example: OK

post.description: Use this API to submit seller data after the seller authorizes your application. On success, the seller becomes active for Walmart Marketplace payouts. Authenticate with a seller-scoped OAuth 2.0 access token in the `WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN` header. Walmart derives the seller identity from the token, so do not include a seller identifier in the request. Availability depends on the market and Payment Service Provider (PSP) enablement. If the PSP is not enabled, the API returns 403. Only `paymentServiceProvider` and `status` are required; all other fields are optional but recommended when available. The operation is safe to retry. Subsequent requests for an active seller store new risk signals and return `200`. This endpoint allows 30 requests per minute and 1,000 requests per 24 hours for each approved Solution Provider application. Requests that exceed either limit return 429.

parameters.description: Access token obtained from the Token API. This is required for authenticating requests to Walmart Marketplace APIs.

parameters.name: WM_MARKET
parameters.description: Marketplace region for the request. This value is case-insensitive. Currently, only US is supported.

parameters.name: WM_GLOBAL_VERSION
parameters.description: Global API version for the request. The value must be `3.1`.

parameters.description: A unique ID to identify the consumer request by channel. Use the Consumer Channel Type received during onboarding.

parameters.description: A unique ID that identifies each API call and is used to track and debug issues. Use a randomly generated GUID for this ID.

parameters.name: WM_SVC.NAME
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the Walmart service being called.

parameters.name: WM_QOS.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY
parameters.description: Optional client-generated key for retry-safe submission. This endpoint is idempotent by design: resubmitting the same seller data after a previous success response will only save the updated data — it will not reactivate the seller or re-initiate risk screening.

requestBody.description: Seller registration and risk-signal data. Walmart derives the seller identity from the OAuth access token. The `riskScore`, `kybDetails`, `kycDetails`, and `businessEntityMatch` fields are optional.

schema.description: Seller data submitted after the seller has authorized your application. `paymentProcessor`, `paymentServiceProvider`, and `status` are mandatory fields. All other fields are optional but recommended whenever the data is available.

paymentProcessor.description: Payment processor identifier assigned by Walmart Marketplace during onboarding. Pass the value exactly as provided.

paymentServiceProvider.description: PSP identifier assigned to you by Walmart Marketplace during onboarding. Pass exactly the value provided to you. Requests from PSPs not enabled for this market are rejected with 403.

status.description: Seller registration status. The only allowed value is `ACTIVE`.

name.description: Legal business name.

type.description: Legal structure of the business, such as LLC.

state.description: State or province for the business address. The value is free text and is not format-validated; it is sent through as provided.

postalCode.description: Postal code for the business address.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Only supported alpha-2 codes are persisted. Alpha-3 codes and full country names are accepted and do not cause a validation error but are stored as null. Some restricted country and territory codes are excluded from the supported allowlist.

firstName.description: First name of the primary business contact.

lastName.description: Last name of the primary business contact.

email.description: Email address of the primary business contact.

phone.description: Landline / primary phone with country code.

city.description: City for the contact address.

state.description: State or province for the contact address. The value is free text and is not format-validated; it is sent through as provided.

postalCode.description: Postal code for the contact address.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Only supported alpha-2 codes are persisted. Alpha-3 codes and full country names are accepted and do not cause a validation error but are stored as null. Some restricted country and territory codes are excluded from the supported allowlist.

payoutMethod.description: Payout method and currency for the seller.

type.description: Payout method type. Not enforced at intake, but only these values are persisted downstream (case-insensitive exact match; anything else is silently dropped, not rejected): `BANK_ACCOUNT`, `BANK`, `ACCOUNT`, `VENMO_ACCOUNT`, `PAPER_CHECK`, `PREPAID_CARD`, `PAYPAL_ACCOUNT`.

currency.description: ISO-4217 3-letter currency code.

registrationDate.description: Date the PSP completed seller registration, in ISO 8601 calendar-date format (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

businessEntityMatch.description: PSP's own entity-match result. Optional. `true` = match, `false` = no match. Absent = PSP did not assert (distinct from explicit `false`).

kybDetails.description: Know Your Business (KYB) verification outcome. Optional.

lastKybDate.description: Date the PSP completed their KYB check, in ISO 8601 calendar-date format (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

kybStatus.description: PSP-defined KYB outcome. Examples include `Y`, `N`, `PASSED`, and `PENDING`.

kycDetails.description: Know Your Customer (KYC) verification outcome. Optional.

lastKycDate.description: Date the PSP completed their KYC check, in ISO 8601 calendar-date format (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

kycStatus.description: PSP-defined KYC outcome. Examples include `Y`, `N`, `PASSED`, and `PENDING`.

200.description: Risk signals accepted and the seller is active for Walmart Marketplace payouts. If the seller was already active, any risk signals you provided are stored and the seller remains active.

status.description: Response status. This operation always returns `OK` on a 200 response.

400.description: Schema validation failed or the request contains malformed JSON. Correct the request and resubmit. Retrying an unchanged request will fail identically. If the problem persists after correcting the request, contact Walmart Marketplace API Support. A 400 can also originate from the API gateway. For example, the `WM_SVC.NAME` header might be missing. Refer to [Error codes](https://developer.walmart.com/us-marketplace/docs/error-codes) for the API gateway response format.

error.description: Error detail. Null fields are omitted from the response.

source.description: Originating service. Not populated by this endpoint.

rawInfo.description: Transport-level detail. Null fields are omitted from the response.

httpStatus.description: HTTP reason phrase.

endpointUrl.description: API endpoint. Not populated by this endpoint.

response.description: Upstream response detail. Not populated by this endpoint.

message.description: Human-readable error message.
message.example: PSP not enabled for risk signals in this market

hint.description: Stable machine-readable error code. Use this for programmatic branching.

401.description: Missing, malformed, or expired `WM_SEC.ACCESS_TOKEN`. The access token could not be validated, or the seller identity could not be derived from it. Do not retry with the same token. Obtain a new access token and retry once. If it recurs, credentials may be revoked. Contact Walmart Marketplace API Support. post.description: Updates prices in bulk. In one Feed you can update up to 10,000 items in bulk. To ensure optimal Feed processing time, we recommend sending no more than 1000 items in one Feed and keeping the Feed sizes below 10 MB. The price sequence guarantee is observed by the bulk price update functionality, subject to the following rules: The timestamp used to determine precedence is passed in the request headers. All price updates in the feed are considered to have the same timestamp. The timestamp in the XML file is used only for auditing. You can send a single SKU multiple times in one Feed. If a SKU is repeated in a Feed, the price will be set for that SKU on Walmart.com, but there is no guarantee as to which SKU's price within that feed will be used. This API should be used in preference to the update a price. It should be called no sooner than 24 hours after a new item is set up and a wpid (Walmart Part ID) is available. Thereafter, the bulk price update has an service level agreement (SLA) of 15 minutes. After the update is submitted, wait for at least five minutes before verifying whether the bulk price update was successful. Individual SKU price update success or failure is only available after the entire feed is processed. If a SKU's price update fails (for example, multiple price updates were sent for the same SKU in a single feed), an error will be returned. You can download the request body sample from here

post.summary: Update pricing for multiple items in bulk (New)
post.description:
Updates prices and promotions in bulk for multiple items. You can modify the prices of multiple items in bulk using a price feed. This is useful for implementing pricing strategies across your catalog, such as seasonal discounts, competitive pricing adjustments, or clearance sales. Each price feed can contain up to 10,000 items. To ensure optimal performance (feed processing time), we recommend limiting feeds to 1,000 items and keeping the payload under 10 MB. Use this API instead of the single price update API when updating prices for multiple items. For newly created items, ensure that the Walmart Part ID (WPID) has been assigned and that at least 24 hours have passed since item creation before submitting a bulk price update feed. The bulk price update Service Level Agreement (SLA) is 15 minutes. The price sequence guarantee is observed by the bulk price update functionality, subject to the following rules:
  • You may include the same Stock Keeping Unit (SKU) multiple times in a single feed. However, if a SKU is repeated in a feed, only one price will be applied.
  • The price sequence guarantee ensures that the latest price update, based on its creation timestamp, is the one that changes the item's price, overwriting the previous version.
  • Price updates received with an earlier timestamp are ignored. We recommend using UTC timestamps for the value of feedDate in all feed-based bulk updates.
After submitting the price feed, wait at least 5 minutes before checking whether the bulk price update was successful. If a price update fails, for example, due to duplicate SKU entries, an error response will be returned. For more information and usage examples, refer to the Pricing API Guide.

post.summary: Update walmart-funded incentives enrollment for specific items
post.description:
Updates the enrollment status of specific items in the Walmart-funded incentives program. By default, all items are auto-enrolled in Walmart-funded incentives, meaning that eligible items are automatically included in this program to benefit from price reductions funded by Walmart. You have the flexibility to modify the enrollment status for specific items using this API:
  • Opt-Out - Use this option to opt-out of Walmart-funded incentives for specific items for which you do not want to lower the price.
  • Opt-in - Use this option to opt-in items that were previously opted-out from Walmart-funded incentives. For instance, you can re-enroll items in Walmart-funded incentives programs at any time depending on your business needs.
For more information and usage examples, refer to the Pricing API Guide.
